content: Firebase latest is 12.19.0 (npm registry). The gstatic CDN serves both the modular SDK as native ESM (firebase-app.js etc., per official alt-setup docs) and the compat namespaced packages (firebase-app-compat.js). Both compat 11.6.1 and compat 12.19.0 HEAD-verified 200 on gstatic. Official guidance: namespaced compat API is stable but does not get new features and does not tree-shake; modular is recommended for new apps. For this app, rewriting .collection().add() to the modular API is the single highest behavior-change risk and is unnecessary for a decomposition milestone — keep compat 11.6.1.
